content.title: Vertical Aerospace awaiting approval for NYC air taxi service
content.description:
Vertical Aerospace (EVTL) is waiting on approval to launch its air taxi service in New York City in 2028, hoping to capitalize on luxury transportation needs to and from airports.

Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian comes on Market Domination to talk more about Vertical Aerospace's Valo eVTOL (an electric vertical takeoff and landing) and its competition in select markets.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
